description: Orientado/a a biotecnología y salud digital. Busco aplicar datos de la NASA a problemas de salud global, telemedicina, sostenibilidad y monitoreo ambiental. Aporto gestión, visión de producto y validación técnica para crear una propuesta competitiva.Busco para el equipo: • Devs Backend/Frontend (prototipo) • Especialista en IA/ML (algoritmos) • Diseñador/a UX/UI (interfaz) • Estrategia & Storytelling (pitch)
summary:
We have developed a comprehensive medical ecosystem for NASA crews, consisting of a multi-sensor device and an intuitive, interactive platform that centralizes all clinical measurements in one place.

To address the challenge of health monitoring in space, the system generates real-time, detailed reports by comparing each measurement against an astronaut’s baseline values. It also incorporates games designed to assess and train cognitive and physical capabilities, helping to mitigate the deterioration caused by the space environment and its associated risk factors. All this data feeds into a machine-learning system that calculates a risk index displayed via an easy-to-read, traffic-light-style indicator to determine an individual’s fitness for critical tasks, such as spacewalks.

This project is vital: it enhances operational safety in orbit, aims to reduce the incidence of post-exposure health issues, and will help identify which health indicators are the most significant predictors for determining who is best suited for space travel.
